entities.summary: Jake Ball is a professional rugby union player who plays as a lock. Ball played over 100 times for the Llanelli-based Scarlets regional side in Wales and was capped 50 times for the Wales national rugby union team. In 2021, Ball retired from international rugby to join the Japanese club Green Rockets Tokatsu, he later retired from all rugby after four years in Japan after the conclusion of the 2024–25 season, only to come out of retirement to rejoin the Scarlets for the following season.
